messages:
Mia Patel: Quick sync — Field Fable customer story: need to lock recording slot, get signed release, choose two soundbites, and confirm lead routing for webinar followup. Proposed embargo: Apr 7. Who's on?
Raj Chen: I'm in. Can do Wed/Thu mornings. I'll draft questions. Do we have a release template?
Elena Gomez: I can send legal release. Small note: remove any competitor names and confirm opt-in for quotes + case study usage. I'll post the doc.
Tom Alvarez: I'll ask Field Fable for availability; p.m. works better for them. Also they want a lightweight NPS quote approved by their C-suite.
Sasha Li: I'll prep hero assets and a short customer snapshot. Need a 2-3 sentence approved quote by EOD Tue to lock design.
ContentOpsBot: Calendar poll created — https://cal.com/field-fable-story (poll closes 24h).
Mia Patel: Thx. Elena — can you drop release link here? Raj — can you pin 6 targeted q's, prioritize deployment/latency + anecdote? Also set embargo Apr 7.
Elena Gomez: Release link: https://drive.redwood/legal/field-fable-release.docx — please have customer sign; I've redlined competitor clause. Tag me when they sign.
Raj Chen: Draft Qs in thread: 1) What workload prompted Redwood? 2) Latency impact? 3) Cost delta? 4) Ops story? 5) Favorite unexpected win? 6) Anything to avoid mentioning? — please add.
Tom Alvarez: Sent availability (Tue 4/1 2pm PT, Thu 4/3 11am PT). Customer prefers 4/1. I'll send the release right after convo.
Mia Patel: 4/1 2pm PT works for me. Sasha — block that slot on kickoff calendar and prepare recording runbook. Raj — once interview done, pick up 2 soundbites and share in #marketing for approvals.
Sasha Li: Blocked. Recording runbook: mic check 5m, intro + 20m interview, 5m wrap. I'll post runbook + hero template.
Elena Gomez: Received confirmation — will approve redline once signed. Quick FYI: customer legal asked to remove product roadmap claims.
Tom Alvarez: Release signed and returned (attached). Customer ok with quote: 'Redwood cut our inference latency by 3x and dropped costs by ~40%.' They want us to vet numbers for public release.
Mia Patel: Great. Raj please verify numbers with infra team (cc @eng-runtime). Also we need to route webinar leads: route to AE team 'mid-market' + trigger nurture with 'Field Fable story' tag.
Raj Chen: Confirmed with infra — numbers validated. I'll sanitize wording: '~3x' and 'about 40%'.
Mia Patel: Publishing plan: blog + co-marketing tweet + 1 webinar mention (lead form). Tom, please enable lead routing to AE queue and set nurture step 1 to 'Story download'.
Tom Alvarez: AE queue set. Lead form created and tested. Nurture sequence draft in SFDC ready for review.
Sasha Li: Assets done — hero ready, 2 quote snippets, screenshot annotations. Posting to #marketing-assets.
Mia Patel: Final approvals: Elena (legal) yes? Raj (content) yes? Launch embargo Apr 7. If all good I'll schedule publish.
Elena Gomez: Legal ok with final wording and release. Please dont mention roadmap.
Raj Chen: Content approves. Good to schedule.
Mia Patel: :tada: Locked. Thanks team — I'll schedule and ping comms.
